name: Syurna
summary: In Darnassus, Syurna trains night elf rogues in the Cenarion Enclave. She guides new scouts, spies, and covert operatives, then tests their stealth and cunning.

sections.title: A Scout Among the Grove
sections.body: Syurna teaches rogues to move unseen through Darnassus. In the Cenarion Enclave, she trains them in evasion, lockpicking, and deadly strikes. The Sentinels show the Kaldorei’s strength in arms, while the Sisterhood of Elune keeps their spiritual wisdom. The Kaldorei also rely on shadows and stealth, and Syurna sharpens the eyes and blades that guard Teldrassil.

sections.title: Tests of Cunning
sections.body: Syurna tests young operatives beyond the enclave’s lessons. She sends promising initiates into deeper fieldwork to learn whether they have the instincts to survive beyond the World Tree’s boughs. There, they must prove they can serve the Alliance in perilous frontier lands.

faq.answer: Syurna trains night elf rogues in Darnassus’s Cenarion Enclave. She teaches combat skills and guides rogues who serve the Alliance.

faq.q: Where exactly can I find Syurna in Darnassus?
faq.answer: Find Syurna in Darnassus’s Cenarion Enclave, among the trees and pavilions beside other shadow mentors.

faq.q: Why is a rogue trainer in the Cenarion Enclave?
aliases: why is rogue trainer in enclave
faq.answer: The Cenarion Enclave is known chiefly for druidism and nature. Night elf scouts and covert pathfinders also train along its wooded edges, away from the public pageantry of the Temple of Elune and the Warrior's Terrace.
Syurna guides novice operatives who have proven themselves in Shadowglen as they hone their talents in the wider world, including through Destiny Calls.

angles.text: As a night elf rogue, you can learn stealth, poison, and martial precision from Syurna, one of Darnassus’s principal instructors.
As a night elf, you share the Kaldorei scouts’ quiet tradition of guarding woodland sanctuaries from the shadows.
